pattern: Generated cards tend to have even, closed contours that trace every form at the same weight, like a coloring page, including clouds, stars and panel grids. Real cards vary line weight and let lit edges go lost, with the sharpest edges at the focus. Weaker tells: seams drawn as uniform grooves, and glow or blur replacing a defined boundary (comet tail, bulbs). This vector is weak on some pairs. Smooth subjects push density out of range on their own, and p09's number disagrees with the eye, so several calls here are low confidence.
